---
title: "Draft for how to render multiple quarto PDFs"
format: pdf
params:
  unit: NULL
---


```{r}
#| echo: false

unit_data <- all_data |>
  filter(unit == params$unit)
```

```{r}
library(quarto)

units <- unique(all_data$unit)

for (u in units) {

  quarto_render(
    input = "unit_report.qmd",
    execute_params = list(unit = u),
    output_file = paste0("Report_", u, ".pdf")
  )

}
```

```{r}
library(future.apply)

plan(multisession)

future_lapply(units, function(u) {

  quarto::quarto_render(
    "unit_report.qmd",
    execute_params = list(unit = u),
    output_file = paste0("Report_", u, ".pdf")
  )

})

##for example
fgcodes <- unique(region$fgcode)

for (fg in fgcodes) {

  quarto::quarto_render(
    "BEC_Unit_Report.qmd",
    execute_params = list(fgcode = fg),
    output_file = paste0(fg, "_report.pdf")
  )

}
```
